Plain English meaning: Position from highest average score (#1) to lowest.
How many people from this university / field / group answered the survey.
All students' scores for a group added up and divided by the count. Out of 100.
A word for the score: 80+ Very good, 60-79 Good, 40-59 Needs work, below 40 Poor.
How far apart students' answers are. Low = everyone feels similarly; high = big disagreements.
What percentage of all respondents come from this group.
Students grouped by their overall score: Poor (<40), Needs work (40-59), Good (60-79), Very good (80+).
The academic discipline the student is enrolled in.
A chart where each rectangle's SIZE shows how many students, and its COLOUR shows their average score.
